name: rain_medium

source.title: Medium rain
source.author: Ryding
source.notes: 48 kHz 16-bit stereo, 94 s of steady rain, mixed to mono. Between the calm rain and vanilla's: a mid-heavy wash with little low end (63 Hz band 10-17 dB down) and few sharp drops (about 2 a second). Stretches picked for few drops and a steady level (scratchpad rain_pick.py).

shape: 2 s swells (0.6 s in, 0.5 s out), as the calm rain's, played with it in place of each of vanilla's rain sounds (MixinClientLevel.dsurround$rainSound) in middling storms (StormSounds.mediumShare). Same average level as the calm rain before its share.
